description: Fulcrum Genomics riker 0.4.1 (MIT); pinned tag and binary SHA-256 in provenance.txt
Raw histogram cases (min_frac=1.1) retain every absolute-TLEN integer bin
metrics.tsv and histograms.tsv retain upstream text values keyed by fixture, format and case_name; cases.tsv records arguments; absent keys represent empty upstream outputs
Eight BAM/CRAM cases exercise filters, orientations, weighted statistics, missing/long CIGAR, INT32_MIN TLEN and indexed task overlap; reference.fa.gz is BGZF-compressed
Only edges and empty alignments, their indexes, an unindexed BAM, compressed reference/indexes, SQL reference and subset oracle TSVs are bundled (17 files, 15594 bytes)
